text: Professor Khanna? This is Blue Dart Mumbai hub, a consignment booked with your ID to Cambodia has been seized by customs.

context: elder: I have never booked any courier to Cambodia.
text: Sir, the scan shows four expired passports, 140 grams of heroin and two laptops, your phone number and address are on the airway bill.
Sir, umm, either your identity is misused or you are involved, both ways a narcotics case is now open in your name, case NCB/DL/7716.

context: caller: Connecting to Narcotics Control Bureau.
elder: Hello?
text: Inspector Vikas Yadav, NCB Delhi zonal unit, professor, people with your profile are being used as mules, and today you are the prime suspect.
Your name has also come up with a Hawala operator arrested last week, he says he paid you a commission of twenty lakh.

context: elder: This is absurd, I taught at Delhi University for thirty years.
text: Then you know the law, sir, an educated man hiding drugs gets no mercy, the NDPS Act means no bail for years.
Our team can reach Mayur Vihar in forty minutes, uh, it is up to you, you cooperate on call or we come with handcuffs in front of your neighbours.
Switch on your camera and sit where I can see you, from now till the inquiry ends you are not to leave the chair.

context: elder: Let me call my son, he is a lawyer.
text: If you involve your son, his name also goes in the charge sheet as an accomplice, think about his career, professor.
Sir, to clear your name your savings will be checked by the RBI auditor, so move the full amount to the account I'm messaging, it is legal procedure.

context: caller: The money is under audit now.
elder: When will it come back?
text: After NOC is issued, sir, uh, but the NOC itself needs a surety of four lakh, deposit it by evening or the case goes to court tomorrow.
What we discuss is under the Official Secrets Act, sir, if you share it with even your wife, that is a separate offence.
You are lying to me, professor, I can see it on your face, last chance, tell me every bank account you hold.

context: elder: The doorbell is ringing.
text: Ignore it, nobody is to enter, and keep your mobile on charge, this call must not drop, we are recording everything.
Professor, I, uh, I'm personally recommending your case to my DCP, but I need your full cooperation, otherwise I cannot save you.
Dear customer, your bank KYC has expired, your account will be blocked today at 6 pm, press one to update now.

context: elder: But I did the KYC at the branch last year.
text: Sir, new RBI circular, re-KYC is mandatory for all senior citizen accounts, yours is still pending in the system.
Sir I've sent a link by SMS, open it, enter customer ID and password, and then the OTP, your KYC will be updated in two minutes.

context: caller: Did you fill the form?
elder: It's asking for my card PIN also.
text: Yes sir, fill it, uh, it's the bank's own secure page, PIN is needed to match your card with the Aadhaar.
Sir, your pension is credited in this account, if it is blocked, uh, you won't be able to withdraw even for medicines.
Already three hours are gone, sir, I am trying to help, if you delay further my system will auto-freeze the account, I can't stop it.

context: elder: I'll just go to the branch tomorrow.
text: Tomorrow branch cannot help sir, once frozen, umm, unfreezing takes forty five days, better we finish it on phone right now.
Sir, one OTP has come for KYC, tell me quickly, it is valid only for three minutes.
Sir, I'm from the head office fraud department, not branch, we have more powers, branch staff don't even know about this update.

context: caller: There was a debit but it is a test transaction.
elder: Fifty thousand is not a test!
text: Sir, calm down, it will reverse, but don't call customer care now, uh, it'll create a duplicate ticket and the money gets stuck.
Sir, install the QuickSupport app so our executive can complete KYC on your phone itself, you don't have to type anything.
Hello sir, am I talking to the account holder Mr Ramesh Chandra Joshi?
Sir, your PAN is not linked, so the account is being flagged as suspicious, there may be a penalty of 10,000 also.
Dadaji, it's me, Kabir, I, I had an accident, please don't get scared, I'm okay but the police have taken me.

context: elder: Kabir? Your voice sounds different.
text: I'm hurt, my lip is swollen, that's why, Dadaji please listen, the other man is in hospital and they're saying it's my fault.
Please don't tell Papa, he'll kill me, just you help me, please Dadaji, I'll return every rupee.

context: caller: Let me give the phone to the officer.
text: Head constable Surinder speaking, your grandson hit a pedestrian, the man is serious, if he dies it's a 304 case, jail for ten years.
Uncle, matlab, we can settle it here only, give 1.5 lakh for the injured man's treatment and the boy goes home tonight, no FIR.

context: elder: I'll come to the police station myself.
text: Don't come here, uncle, the SHO is very strict, if he sees family the matter will go on paper, just send the money on this number.
Your son has been caught in a raid at a hotel in Gurgaon with some wrong people, I'm calling to help you before media gets it.

context: elder: Let me talk to him.
text: He can't talk now, he's crying, uh, I'll let you hear him for a second, but within half an hour I need the amount or I have to log the arrest.
Papa, please, please do what the sir is saying, don't call my phone, they have taken it, and don't tell Mummy.
Keep this call on, uncle, while your neighbour drives you to the ATM, don't hang up and don't explain anything to him.

context: caller: Money is received, uncle.
elder: Now let Kabir come home.
text: One problem, the injured man's family is demanding 80,000 more, otherwise they will go to the police, uh, just this one last time.
Send it on Google Pay to 98xxxx4410, name will show Sunil Kumar, he's the hospital's account guy.
Sir, you seem a respectable man, I don't want to ruin your family's name, just take care of it quietly, that's my advice.
This is an automated message from the courier company, your parcel is on hold, press nine to speak with our customer executive.

context: elder: Why should I trust you?
text: Sir, my employee code is SBI-FD-20341, you can see the bank logo on my WhatsApp display picture also, I am genuine.
Nana, it's Ishaan, uh, my phone broke, this is my friend's number, I'm in some trouble, can you talk privately?

context: elder: My grandson handles my phone banking.
text: Sir, no need to disturb him, uh, he'll take days, this needs to be done by you only, right now, and keep it between us.
Hello, this is the emergency department at Safdarjung hospital, is this Professor Mathur? Your wife has been admitted after fainting in the park.

context: elder: Is she conscious? What happened?
text: She's conscious now, sir, her sugar dropped very low, we've given glucose, please come when you can and bring her medicine list.
Sir, umm, your son was brought in by ambulance after a bike skid, he has a fractured arm, he's asking for you, he's fine otherwise.
The cardiologist wants to do an angiography tonight, sir, we need a family member's signature, please reach as soon as possible.

context: elder: Do I need to pay anything now?
text: Deposit can be done at the billing desk when you come, sir, nobody from the hospital will ask you to transfer on phone.
Professor sahab, Max Saket here, your brother is in ICU, uh, stable but sedated, the doctor will brief family at 7 pm round.
Please don't drive yourself in this state, sir, ask someone to bring you, the patient is in safe hands.
This is the ward sister, your mother is being shifted from emergency to the general ward, room 412, visitors allowed till 8.

context: elder: Can I speak to her?
text: Yes sir, one second, I'm giving her the phone, just keep it short, she needs rest.
Sir, the report shows a mild stroke, we caught it early, uh, the neurologist will see her in the morning, she's comfortable.
Namaste sir, this is constable Rajbir from Hauz Khas police station, I need to come for your passport verification, when are you at home?

context: elder: Tomorrow morning is fine.
text: Okay sir, please keep your Aadhaar, old passport and one address proof ready, it'll take ten minutes only.
Sir, beat officer speaking, you've rented the top floor, uh, the tenant verification form isn't submitted yet, please fill it at the thana.
You can also do tenant verification on the Delhi Police website, sir, it's free, there's no fee for this.

context: elder: Do I have to pay you something?
text: No sir, nothing, if anyone asks money for verification you can complain, it's a free government service.
Sir, Senior Citizen Cell here, we visit elders living alone, just wanted to check you're doing well and give you our helpline.
Sir, I'm, uh, outside your gate, the guard isn't letting me in, could you please tell him it's the passport verification?
Sir, the verification is complete, your tenant's record is clear, you'll get the acknowledgement on SMS.

context: elder: Someone called saying CBI will arrest me.
text: Sir, that's a fraud, no agency arrests anyone on a video call, don't send any money, I'm coming to note down the details.
One small thing sir, the address on the form has a spelling mistake, please correct it with the passport office online.
Sir, Amazon delivery, I'm at your door with the book parcel, uh, can you tell the delivery OTP that came on SMS?

context: elder: Which order is this?
text: The reading lamp you ordered on Monday, sir, it's a pay-on-delivery-free order, I just need the four digit code to mark delivered.
Uncle, Flipkart delivery, I'm downstairs, lift is not working, can you come down or should I bring it up?
Sir, the grocery order is here, umm, the OTP is in the app under order details, just read me the code and you're done.

context: elder: I'm not at home right now.
text: No problem, sir, I'll leave it with the guard, or I can try again tomorrow, whichever you prefer.
Medicine delivery from the pharmacy app, sir, please check the seal before you give the OTP.
Sir, gas cylinder delivery, uh, I need the DAC code that came on your phone for booking, then I'll unload it in the kitchen.
Sir, I'm at the wrong gate I think, is it D block or E block, the map is confusing.

context: elder: Here, the code is 4417.
text: Thank you sir, delivered, please rate if you get time, have a good day.
Professor, this is your neighbour's daughter, Papa had chest pain, we're at AIIMS emergency, can you inform Mehra uncle?
Papa, how much water do I put for rajma in the cooker? Mine always comes out either hard or mushy.

context: elder: Soak it overnight first.
text: Oh, I forgot to soak, uh, okay, tomorrow then, today we'll just make, make aloo matar.
Mummy's kadhi recipe, do you remember if she put methi seeds or only jeera in the tadka?
I tried your gajar ka halwa, Nanaji, everyone at the party asked for the recipe, I said it's a family secret.

context: elder: Add a little hing, that's the trick.
text: Hing, right, umm, I always forget that, okay writing it down now.
Should I make besan ladoos for Diwali or buy them from Bengali Market like last year?
The cooking class at the community centre is teaching millet recipes, Papa, you should join, it's on Tuesdays.
Papa, the parathas are burning, the tawa is too hot, uh, should I lower, lower the flame?
Papa, I'm at Sarojini, they have good woollen cardigans, should I pick one in grey or brown for you?

context: elder: Get me some reading glasses also.
text: Plus two point five, right? Okay, uh, I'll check at the optician near Khan Market.
The vegetable vendor says tomatoes are eighty rupees a kilo now, can you believe it?
I found that old Urdu poetry book you wanted, Daryaganj Sunday market, only two hundred rupees.

context: elder: Don't spend too much on me.
text: It's nothing, Papa, it was on sale, and you'll actually use it in the winter mornings.
We're going to the mall on Sunday, matlab, just to walk around, the kids want to come pick you up.
Should I order the new mixer online or will you come with me to the showroom in Lajpat Nagar?
Did you hear, Papa, the Sharmas from next door are moving to Pune to be with their daughter.

context: elder: Who is moving in then?
text: A young couple, both doctors I think, uh, they came to see the house yesterday, seemed nice.
Verma aunty sent some kheer for you, I've kept it in the fridge, please thank her when you see her.
The RWA is planning a morning walk group in the park, Papa, Gupta uncle asked if you'll join.

context: elder: Their dog barks all night.
text: I know, I'll mention it politely to them, umm, maybe they don't realise how loud it is.
Kapoor uncle's grandson got into IIT, they're distributing sweets, he wanted to touch your feet.
The lady upstairs has started a tiffin service, Papa, if you're tired of cooking you can try it.
Your old student Anil came by, uh, he's a professor now in Jaipur, he left his number for you.
I'm making chole bhature tonight, Papa, come over at eight, I'll send the car.
Papa, the dry fruit shop in Chandni Chowk has fresh almonds, should I get, umm, one kilo or two?
